name: io.github.fortuneflick/agentisend
title: AgentiSend
description: AgentiSend is a transactional email API: send through verified domains with a message log, budgets, a preflight and refusals that name the fix; built so AI agents can send on your behalf. The hosted MCP server at https://api.agentisend.com/mcp exposes 82 tools (44 on tools/list; the rest via list_more_tools). A send is one message or a batch of up to 500 items with per-item results. preflight_email runs every gate a real send runs, sends nothing, and costs nothing. Every 4xx returns code, message, and fix. There is no tool for unsolicited mail. Auth is a bearer API key or OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration. Starter prompts: "Send this receipt to the customer." "Preflight this send and tell me what would stop it." "What can I spend today?"

environmentVariables.name: AGENTISEND_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your AgentiSend API key. Read from the environment only, never passed as an argument, because process arguments are visible to every other process on the machine.

environmentVariables.name: AGENTISEND_MCP_URL
environmentVariables.description: The hosted endpoint this launcher proxies to. Defaults to https://api.agentisend.com/mcp.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <your API key>. OAuth 2.1 reaches the same tools with the same ceilings.
